title: Super Mario Bros.
engine: the community SMB disassembly on EmulatorJS (FCEUmm)
description: Run, jump and stomp through eight worlds to reach the last castle.
overview: Super Mario Bros. running in the browser from the community disassembly on EmulatorJS (FCEUmm). Every tile in the game — the player, enemies, blocks, scenery, font and title board — and every palette has been redrawn by the clean-room pipeline from coarse facts, so the build ships no original ROM or artwork. Music and sound effects are the original note sequences played by the NES sound channels.
engineLicense: See the upstream project and the clean-room repository
assetLicense: Regenerated clean-room assets; no retail data is distributed
controls: Gamepad — any standard controller, detected automatically
Touch — on-screen NES pad on phones and tablets when no controller is connected
saveInstructions: The game has no save. Save states from the emulator menu are stored in this browser, under andrewnakas.github.io. Clearing site data removes them.
limitations: Regenerated pictures and colours differ from the retail game by design.
Some rarely seen sprites and scenery are still coarse placeholders.

verification.scope: Headless tests booted the build with sound, started a 1 player game and ran and jumped through the first part of World 1-1.
